checks.rule: OS Net base-station standard error is generally better than 0.008m in plan
OS Net base-station standard error is generally better than 0.020m in height
OSTN15 defines OSGB36 National Grid with OS Net stations
OSTN15-to-old-triangulation agreement is about 0.1m rms for Great Britain
OSGM15 Great Britain vertical-datum standard error is 0.008m excluding GNSS heighting error
GNSS/WGS84 coordinates must not be treated as National Grid coordinates without transformation
OS maps use OSGB36 National Grid and Ordnance Datum Newlyn heights
OSTN15/OSGM15 is the national standard GNSS-to-OSGB36/ODN transformation
OS Net corrections can support centimetre-level positioning subject to hardware and environment
GNSS positional error must be kept separate from transformation-model error
Legacy triangulation distortions can grow materially with distance and must not be used as a parcel precision shortcut
Parcel elevation promotion requires explicit horizontal CRS and vertical datum provenance
